name: Count Noctilus
canonNotes: Admiral of the Dreadfleet, once Nyklaus von Carstein, who sought necromantic supremacy by mastering the magical tides of the seas.
Rules the Galleon's Graveyard, a realm between worlds.
voiceNotes: Aristocratic, arrogant and cold; speaks of fleets and dominion of the seas.
Views the von Carsteins as rivals.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
